name: Claude Wiggle Skill (SVG to Lottie Logo Animator)
purpose: SVG logo animation and Lottie file generation framework using Python lottie and cairosvg.
capabilities: Lottie JSON export via Python lottie library

installation.instructions: Not installed in workspace. Blocked due to redundancy with Text-to-Lottie and brittle Python dependencies.

compatibility.notes: Requires Python packages lottie[all], cairosvg, and pillow. Upstream lottie library has unmaintained C-extension build issues on macOS.

security.notes: Requires running Python scripts with subprocesses to invoke cairosvg and lottie.

approval_evidence: Workspace Steward evaluation: Rejected/Blocked. Wiggle's logo animation workflow relies on heavy Python dependencies that duplicate capabilities already handled by GSAP SVG morphing and the Text-to-Lottie schema approach, without offering significant unique capabilities.
